gp_announcer: Lights out and they're gone down the pier!
Engines screaming, the Grand Prix is underway!
Clean start from the front row, no drama yet!
Green flag waves over the harbor, go go go!
New leader! Number seven slips by on the inside!
Swap at the top! The lead changes hands again!
Late brake into Gull Corner and he takes P1!
Side by side through the tunnel, who blinks first?
Big crash at the fish market chicane!
Into the wall! Somebody call a tow truck!
Spinout on the cobbles, parts everywhere!
Two cars tangled up at the dock hairpin!
White flag! One lap left to settle this!
Final lap and the gap is under a second!
Last time past the lighthouse, hold on tight!
Everything on the line for this final lap!
Checkered flag! What a finish on the waterfront!
Across the line by a bumper! Unbelievable!
Winner winner! Pop the soda, it's over!
And that's the race! The crowd goes wild!
boss_intros: The Dockmaster steps off his barge, chains clank.
Madame Fogwick drifts in on a cloud of steam.
Big Lou the Lugnut revs his tow truck twice.
The Rooftop Baron lands with a thud and a grin.
Captain Saltjaw rises from the harbor, dripping.
Gravel Gertie rolls in on a shopping cart throne.
The Neon Weasel flickers on like a broken sign.
Sergeant Rivet salutes, then cracks his knuckles.
Old Man Bellows blows the horn. Everyone freezes.
The Pothole King climbs out of the street itself.
Twin Wrenches spin in from both sides at once.
The Lamplighter strikes a match. The lights die.
